root_cause: PR #3890 merged with exact production v23/v31/v115 source and provider-proven LinkedIn company LIVE_PROVEN evidence, but the post-merge terminalizer classified config/powerhouse-quality-surface-contracts.json as an unknown runtime path. The terminalizer therefore exited before evaluating the three already-pinned Supabase provider readbacks. Historical reconciliation also lacked a Supabase Edge provider mode, so the failed terminalizer could not be superseded under current authority.
prevention_rule: Treat the quality-surface registry as governance in terminal readback classification. Historical reconciliation must support Supabase Edge runtime changes only when every changed function has an exact Terminal-Supabase-Provider-Readback tuple and, when registry-pinned, that tuple matches the expected version and runtime SHA. Unknown runtime paths remain fail-closed.
